description: Small Ralph self-iteration for current branch health and OSv2 upper-layer experience confidence. There is no open PR or GitHub Actions run for this branch yet, so scope is based on local CI parity, stale-dogfood verification, and current web test output. Priority is to keep fresh CI failures actionable before adding broader capability work.

userStories.name: Make web CI browser primitive shims quiet
userStories.description: Remove noisy jsdom not-implemented diagnostics from the web Vitest gate by providing deterministic test-environment shims for browser primitives used by OSv2 upper-layer pages and charts.
bdd_acceptance: Given Vitest loads the shared jsdom setup, When a component or library requests a 2D canvas context, Then the call returns a deterministic minimal context instead of emitting the jsdom `HTMLCanvasElement's getContext()` not-implemented diagnostic.

Given Vitest loads the shared jsdom setup, When upper-layer navigation or export code calls `window.open`, Then the call is a harmless no-op and does not emit the jsdom `Window's open()` not-implemented diagnostic.
Given the web CI coverage gate runs, When `npx vitest run --coverage` completes, Then the test suite passes without the canvas or window.open not-implemented diagnostics obscuring real failures.

userStories.name: Add a web bundle budget guard
userStories.description: Turn the current oversized production bundle warning into an actionable, versioned guard so the OSv2 web shell does not regress initial-load performance silently.
bdd_acceptance: Given the web production build emits assets, When the bundle budget check runs, Then it fails with a clear message if the main application chunk exceeds the configured compressed or raw budget.

Given heavy graph, markdown, charting, and spreadsheet dependencies are present, When Vite builds the app, Then vendor chunks are split predictably enough for operators to identify which upper-layer surface owns a large payload.
Given CI runs the web build, When bundle size drifts above the checked budget, Then the failure points to the chunk name and configured threshold.

userStories.name: Keep embedded WebUI build semantics explicit
userStories.description: Clarify and test the distinction between a fresh Go build that may omit generated SPA assets and the production build path that embeds the WebUI, so upper-layer serving regressions remain easy to diagnose.
bdd_acceptance: Given a fresh checkout has only the tracked embed placeholder, When `go build ./cmd/server` runs, Then it succeeds without requiring generated SPA assets.
Given production packaging needs the SPA, When `make build-with-ui` runs, Then the web build output is copied into the server embed tree before the Go binary is built.
Given a developer inspects the build targets, When they read local command help or tests, Then the no-UI Go build and UI-embedded production build behaviors are explicit.
